source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Diagnostic mode entered (saved/active F-xx codes reviewed if applicable). Continue with component tests below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Console Buttons and Indicators diagnostic
steps.body: In diagnostic test mode (past saved/active fault codes), press buttons and rotate cycle selector. Each control should extinguish its indicator and beep; MORE/LESS time toggles display digits.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In diagnostic test mode (past saved/active fault codes), press buttons and rotate cycle selector. Each control should extinguish its indicator and beep; MORE/LESS time toggles display digits.

steps.title: Console button / indicator test result
steps.body: Do all indicators light and beep correctly when buttons and selector are exercised?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Do all indicators light and beep correctly when buttons and selector are exercised?

steps.title: P5 connector fully seated
steps.body: Access electronic assemblies. Is P5 fully inserted into the machine control electronics?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Access electronic assemblies. Is P5 fully inserted into the machine control electronics?

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Reseat P5 connector and retest console diagnostic.

steps.title: Console housing fully seated
steps.body: Is the console electronics and housing assembly properly inserted into the front console?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Is the console electronics and housing assembly properly inserted into the front console?

steps.title: Reseat P5 and retest
steps.body: Reseat P5, reassemble, restore power, and rerun Console Buttons and Indicators diagnostic.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reseat P5, reassemble, restore power, and rerun Console Buttons and Indicators diagnostic.

steps.title: Reseat console and retest
steps.body: Reseat console assembly, restore power, and rerun console diagnostic.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reseat console assembly, restore power, and rerun console diagnostic.

steps.title: Replace console assembly
steps.oemOutcome: Replace console electronics and housing assembly; retest. If still failed, replace MCE.

steps.title: Console UI verified
steps.oemOutcome: Console buttons and indicators respond correctly in diagnostic mode.
